articles.summary: Mid-America Apartment Communities, Inc., ("MAA") (NYSE: MAA) today announced that its operating partnership, Mid-America Apartments, L.P. ("MAALP"), priced a $350,000,000 offering of MAALP's 5.350% senior unsecured notes due December 15, 2031 (the "Notes") under its existing shelf registration statement. The Notes were priced at 99.584% of the principal amount. The closing of the offering is expected to occur on November 12, 2026, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions. MAALP intends to use net proceeds from the offering to repay amounts outstanding from time to time under its unsecured revolving credit facility and its unsecured commercial paper program, and for general corporate purposes, which may include, without limitation, the repayment of other debt and the acquisition, development and redevelopment of apartment communities. J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, Mizuho Securities USA LLC, Truist Securities, Inc., U.S. Bancorp Investments, Inc. and Wells Fargo
articles.title: MAA Announces Pricing of Senior Unsecured Notes Offering
